Ritvik Sahore was born in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India, on 14 September 2000. He started his acting career at a very early age and slowly carved his niche in the Indian entertainment industry via the mediums of films, television, as well as digital platforms.

Age, Height and Weight for 2026

Ritvik Sahore’s age in 2026 is 26. He is reportedly 1.68m (5 ft 6 in) tall and weighs around 60 kg. The physical information provided is only approximate and may differ from one entertainment website to another.

Ritvik Sahore Net Worth in 2026

Ritvik Sahore’s net worth is estimated to be in the range of $1 million to $1.5 million. However, it hasn’t been confirmed whether his net worth is real or not. He has started his acting career in movies, web series, brand endorsements, and other entertainment projects, and these are his main sources of income.

Acting Career and Popular Movies

Ritvik’s first film was Ferrari Ki Sawaari (2012) and he got more popular after joining Dangal (2016). He later went on to star in popular films such as Flames, Laakhon Mein Ek, Indori Ishq, Campus Diaries, Escaype Live, and the recently released film Highway Love.

Family and Personal life

Ritvik Sahore is from a Mumbai-based family. He is believed to have one brother, Daivik Sahore, and his parents are Rajesh Sahore and Monica Sahore. He tends to keep his private life more or less hidden and concentrates on his career as an actor.

Conclusion

Ritvik Sahore’s journey from a child actor to an established young actor in the Indian entertainment industry has been a success. He has a number of popular movies and web series to his name and continues to garner attention for his performances.
